contents_since_beta9: 04 has a 「キャラクター紹介」 / "Character introductions" section with links to the 64-Character introduction page (https://www.wi-t.com/saku-characters) and the store (https://www.wi-t.com/category/all-products); the same ids, order and updated date as AMU Studio; no price on the screen (#93)

Desktop strings that stayed Japanese in English now have English: 111 fixed strings and 41 whole-sentence templates for messages with run-time values; placeholders are translated too (#93, ライター&SNS review 15)
the Trainer's observation and difference left 02's tuning block, the Desktop tuning panel and the manual's tuning page (#93, review 3)

English fixes from the review: sign-off instead of approval, the right to run anything instead of execution permission, qualifications instead of credentials, names that match the screen, and "a person" where "human" meant a person (#93, 英語翻訳チーム R1/R2)
Japanese fixes: the P08 source list, the save confirmation's real button names, 04's signature section reads as not open yet, 「人への引き継ぎ」, seat 8 as 「席 8（論理上の人）」 (#93)
the Builder page's saved message follows the language (#93, review 17)
